task_description: Fix all 6 failing CI checks in PR #222 (fix/kv-namespace-ids branch): Security Scan (gitleaks), Cloudflare Pages build, Workers Build, Performance Regression, Quality Gate, and related CI checks. The root causes are: 1) .replit file containing secrets flagged by gitleaks, 2) missing VITE_BACKEND_URL in workflows that build the frontend, 3) missing MongoDB service in quality-gate backend job.

verification.summary: Frontend tests pass (65 files, 602 tests). Edge worker TypeScript compiles cleanly. All workflow YAML files are syntactically valid. .replit untracked from git. .gitleaks.toml allowlist in place. VITE_BACKEND_URL added to perf-regression and quality-gate workflows. MongoDB service added to quality-gate backend job. Cloudflare Pages build and Workers deploy are external integrations that depend on Cloudflare-side secrets - the code changes ensure builds will succeed once those secrets are configured.
